invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A False return MUST prevent the handler from running and SHALL produce a 401/403 response.
Guards MUST NOT mutate the request body; they CANNOT transform payloads, only accept or reject.
Multiple guards MUST be composed with logical AND: any False blocks the request and SHALL short-circuit remaining guards.
Guards MUST execute after authentication has bound a principal and CANNOT be reused once terminal; a fresh composite is required per request.
A guard that raises NEVER gets silently treated as allow; exceptions SHALL map to a 500 outcome by the error filter.
